recorded.prompt:q-curve: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.

recorded.outcome:q-curve: "When you maximize a sum of concave curves ... any point that no small step improves is the best point overall ... Without that shape, a local NLP method can stop at a point that is only the best in its neighborhood"; s^2 is convex (bends upward); summary: "concave when you maximize".
